title: taraxacum scariosum
intro: Taraxacum scariosum, commonly known as the variable dandelion, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum scariosum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a popular natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
